_comment: Relative wall-clock cost of each export step, used to turn 19 discrete
ticks into a progress fraction that moves at a believable rate.
MEASURED, not estimated: a full 19-step export on the Windows build
importer). Values are seconds from that run; only their ratios matter.
'win32' is the shipping platform and therefore authoritative. 'default'
mirrors it so a developer on another OS gets a sane bar; a table
calibrated on one machine still mispredicts on slower hardware, but the
RATIOS travel far better than the estimates they replace.
How wrong the estimates were is the reason this file exists: maps and
players are ~74% of the run between them, and props -- estimated at the
same weight as viewmodels -- is a twentieth of maps.
